Summarize Split-Half Reliability Results

Source: R/summary.R
summary.tna_reliability.Rd

Returns every metric of a split-half reliability analysis as a tidy table. print() shows four of them.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tna_reliability'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A tna_reliability object.

...

Ignored.

Value

A data.frame with one row per metric (and per model type, in the column model_type, when reliability() was run with several types). The columns are category (the kind of metric: weight deviations, correlations, dissimilarities, similarities, or pattern similarities), metric, and the mean, sd, median, min, max, and quartiles (q25, q75) of the metric over the splits.

Examples

# Small number of iterations for CRAN
rel <- reliability(tna(engagement), iter = 20)
summary(rel)
